# Michael Verdegaal - Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Michael Verdegaal, an ML/AI Engineer, Software Developer, and Platform Architect. The site is a single hero page whose animated background is a 3D graph rendered entirely with NetworkX and Matplotlib.

- [Portfolio source](https://github.com/MichaelVerdegaal/Portfolio): How the graph animation is built.
